about: Twenty's xAI provider as it ships (twentyhq/twenty 1d561b8c73c9, sdk-provider-factory.service.ts: createXai({ apiKey }).responses(modelId), ai 7.0.103 and @ai-sdk/xai 4.0.54 as its yarn.lock resolves them): the unchanged AI SDK asks grok-4.7 where a deal stands (generateText) and streams the follow-up (streamText) through the Responses API, with the key the World's credential door issues as XAI_API_KEY. The twin runs no model: each answer is its labelled deterministic stub, asserted as a stub, so the entry proves the wire and the SDK's parse, never an answer's quality.

retention.none: A Responses turn stores nothing a client reads back: Twenty neither retrieves a stored response nor continues one (previous_response_id), and the twin answers a continuation as outside its surface (src/semantics/responses.ts); the Console key the credential door issued is the one stored record, and the walk resumes the World on it.
